accounting.cashBasisDesc: Income & expenses recorded when money actually moves. Simpler; common for temples.
accounting.accrualBasisDesc: Income & expenses recorded when earned/incurred, regardless of payment timing.
accounting.basisHelp: This drives the Income & Expenditure and Balance Sheet. <bold>Cash</bold> counts only money that actually moved; <bold2>Accrual</bold2> recognises income/expenses when earned/incurred and shows unpaid bills (creditors) as liabilities.
accounting.enableDepreciation: Enable depreciation tracking for fixed assets
accounting.depreciationHelp: When on, the Balance Sheet shows fixed assets net of depreciation; when off, at gross cost. Use "Run Depreciation" on the Fixed Assets page to compute & post each year's charge (straight-line or written-down value).
accounting.closeBooksHelp: Locks every donation and expense entry dated in or before the chosen financial year — no one but a temple admin can post to a closed year afterwards. Use this once a year's accounts are finalised and handed to the CA.
accounting.closeConfirmMessage: This locks all entries in FY {{fy}} and every year before it. Only a temple admin will be able to post or edit entries dated in that range afterwards.
accounting.reopenConfirmMessage: This removes the lock — every role will be able to post entries into the previously closed years again.

masters.deleteMessage:

name.label: Trust/Temple name
name.why: The name donors see on their receipt.

address.label: Full address
address.why: Required on an 80G receipt for it to be valid.

pincode.label: PIN code
pincode.why: Part of the address on statutory receipts.

contact.label: Phone and email
contact.why: How a donor reaches you about their receipt.

pan.label: Trust PAN
pan.why: Printed on 80G receipts and required for Form 10BD.

reg_80g.label: 80G registration number
reg_80g.why: The number that lets a donor claim the deduction.

gstin.label: GSTIN
gstin.why: Shown on invoices where GST is charged.

cash_bank_account.label: At least one cash or bank account
cash_bank_account.why: Every receipt is posted against an account; without one nothing can be recorded.

payment_details.label: UPI or bank details for donors
payment_details.why: Shown to devotees paying you directly, and printed on receipts.

categories.label: Donation categories
categories.why: Lets you report on what the money was given for.

numbering.label: Receipt numbering series
numbering.why: Gapless numbering is what an auditor checks first.

template.label: Receipt template chosen
template.why: Pick the layout donors will receive.

logo.label: Trust logo
logo.why: Makes a receipt recognisably yours. Optional but recommended.

rooms.label: Add rooms with tariffs
rooms.why: No booking can be taken until at least one room exists.

prasad_items.label: Add prasad items and prices
prasad_items.why: The counter cannot sell an empty catalogue.

seva_types.label: Set up your seva list and rates
seva_types.why: Replace the samples with the sevas this trust actually offers.

staff.label: Invite at least one more user
staff.why: So the trust does not depend on a single person's phone.

trustees.label: Add your trustees
trustees.why: Shown on the public profile and used on certificates.

area.label: Locality / area
area.why: What devotees search a dharamshala by — “Palitana”, not just the city.

map_pin.label: Map pin
map_pin.why: Puts a Directions button on your temple page in the devotee app.

upi_qr.label: UPI QR code
upi_qr.why: A devotee scans instead of typing your UPI id — fewer wrong transfers.

bank_account_name.label: Account holder name
bank_account_name.why: What a donor must type as the beneficiary, or the transfer bounces.

receipt_footer.label: Receipt footer note
receipt_footer.why: Your thank-you line, or the declaration your auditor wants on every receipt.

expense_heads.label: Expense heads
expense_heads.why: Without them every expense lands in one bucket and the I&E statement says nothing.

payment_modes.label: Payment modes
payment_modes.why: Cash, UPI, cheque, bank — how a receipt records the way money arrived.

about.label: About this trust
about.why: The paragraph a devotee reads before deciding to give.

main_deity.label: Mulnayak / main deity
main_deity.why: The first thing a Jain devotee looks for when choosing a temple to visit.

darshan_timings.label: Darshan timings
darshan_timings.why: Stops the phone calls asking when you open.

links.label: Website or social links
links.why: Where a devotee goes to see more of your work.

gallery.label: Photos of your temple
gallery.why: A page with no photographs gets scrolled past.

opening_balances.label: Opening balances on your accounts
opening_balances.why: Without them your cash book starts at zero and never agrees with the tin.

accounting_basis.label: Cash or accrual basis
accounting_basis.why: Decides when income is recognised. Changing it later restates every statement.

comms_templates.label: Review your message templates
comms_templates.why: Check what goes out in your name before a donor reads it.

my_account.label: Your own name on your account
my_account.why: Signs the entries you record and appears in the activity log.

welcome.title: Welcome to JainERP
welcome.body: A two-minute look at where everything lives. You can skip at any point and restart it later from Help.

dashboard.title: Your day at a glance
dashboard.body: Collections, expenses and today's activity for the period you pick. It only shows the modules your trust actually uses.

donations.title: Record a donation
donations.body: Take a donation and print or share its 80G receipt from the same screen. The receipt number is issued automatically and never skips.

expenses.title: Record what you spend
expenses.body: Enter expenses against a head and an account, so income and expenditure always balance without separate bookkeeping.

donors.title: Your donors
donors.body: Every donor's giving history, PAN and 80G details in one place — used to generate Form 10BD at year end.

dharamshala.title: Rooms and halls
dharamshala.body: Check availability, take a booking, collect the tariff and check the guest out. Rooms free themselves for the next guest.

prasad.title: Prasad counter
prasad.body: Sell prasad at the counter with stock tracked as you go, so what you have on hand is always current.

seva.title: Seva and pooja
seva.body: Take seva bookings against your published rates and give the devotee a receipt on the spot.

gaushala.title: Gaushala
gaushala.body: Cattle records, feed and milk, plus cow sponsorships that post straight to the donation ledger.

accounts.title: Your books
accounts.body: Day book, ledger, trial balance and income & expenditure — built from the entries above, with nothing to re-enter.

reports.title: Registers and reports
reports.body: Every register your auditor asks for, filtered by date, and exportable to Excel or PDF.

settings.title: Settings
settings.body: Your trust details, receipt templates, numbering series and staff accounts. This is where the setup checklist sends you.

setup.title: Finish your setup
setup.body: This card tracks the details your receipts still need. Do the one it suggests and the percentage moves.

help.title: That's the tour
help.body: You can replay it any time from Help in the top bar. Start by recording your first donation.
